title: Anthropic: every Claude model and the road to an IPO
dek: From Claude 4 to the Mythos-class models, a pause under US export controls, and a Nasdaq listing set for next week.
bigLabel: Price range per share for Anthropic's IPO; listing on Nasdaq as 'ANT' expected on 19 Nov

glance.what: Anthropic released Claude 4 in May 2025, then a new top model every few months, adding a 'Mythos' tier above Opus in 2026. It filed publicly for an IPO in October and began marketing its shares on 10 November.
glance.why: Claude is one of the leading AI assistants, especially for coding and business use, and Anthropic's listing is a test of how investors value AI labs.
glance.next: Pricing is expected on 18 November and trading on 19 November, subject to regulatory clearance.

forYou: Anthropic's most capable model, Claude Fable, is public. A version with fewer safety limits, Claude Mythos, is available only to approved organisations working in cybersecurity and life sciences.

upcoming.label: 19 Nov
upcoming.text: Trading on Nasdaq as ANT expected

next: IPO pricing 18 Nov; trading expected 19 Nov.

events.title: Claude 4: Opus 4 and Sonnet 4
events.summary: Anthropic opens the Claude 4 generation with Opus 4 and Sonnet 4.

events.title: Claude Opus 4.1
events.summary: An upgrade to Opus 4 focused on coding precision and agent tasks.

events.title: Claude Sonnet 4.5
events.summary: A mid-priced model aimed at coding, agents and computer use.

events.title: Claude Haiku 4.5
events.summary: A new version of Anthropic's smallest, fastest model.

events.title: Claude Opus 4.5
events.summary: A new top model, released days after Google's Gemini 3.

events.title: Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6
events.summary: Opus 4.6 arrives on 5 February and Sonnet 4.6 on 17 February.

events.title: Claude Mythos Preview, for a few
events.summary: Anthropic introduces a new tier above Opus, called Mythos, available only to a small number of organisations. Opus 4.7 follows on 16 April and Opus 4.8 on 28 May.

events.title: Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5
events.summary: The first Mythos-class models: Fable 5 for the public with stricter safeguards, and Mythos 5 for approved organisations.

events.title: Paused under US export controls
events.summary: Anthropic suspends access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 to comply with US Commerce Department export controls. The controls are lifted on 30 June and access returns on 1 July.

events.title: Sonnet 5 and Opus 5
events.summary: Sonnet 5 launches on 30 June and Opus 5 on 24 July.

events.title: Accuses Chinese labs of copying Claude
events.summary: Anthropic publishes a report accusing seven Chinese labs of harvesting about 190 million Claude responses to train their own models.

events.title: Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5
events.summary: Opus 5.5 arrives on 22 September, with Sonnet 5.5 in the same period.
events.differs: Sources give 22 or 28 September for Sonnet 5.5.

events.title: Public IPO filing
events.summary: Anthropic files its S-1 with the US securities regulator, making its finances public.

events.title: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
events.summary: New versions of the top models, with Anthropic citing gains in coding, multi-step reasoning and coordinating AI agents.

events.title: IPO roadshow begins
events.summary: Anthropic offers 825 million shares at $70–78 each, to list on Nasdaq as 'ANT'. SiliconANGLE reports about $17 bn revenue and a $536 m operating loss last quarter.

events.title: Named in AI freeze lawsuit
events.summary: Four nonprofits ask a San Francisco court to stop Anthropic and four rivals from building more capable AI. No ruling has been made.
